subject: Priority hires: Senior Runtime Engineer x2 — slate & offer routing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority hires: Senior Runtime Engineer x2 — slate & offer routing

Vivek / Kim —

Following up on last week's capacity sync: we have two strong candidates for the senior runtime slots (both are IC3 / senior eng equivalents). Emma Jenkinson is the lead candidate — 8+ yrs infra/runtime, low-latency systems background (came from FastServe). I attached a short slate and Emma's profile (candidate_slate_emma_mark.pdf).

We need directional guidance on:
- final comp band flexibility (Emma is asking at the top of band + 12%),
- whether we can route the offer through reserved budget (Q2 hiring tranche) or need exec sign-off for comp exception, and
- desired start window (candidate wants Apr 15–May 1).

Immediate ask: can we get a decision on band exception routing (approve up to +10% locally, or require exec committee)? If we can approve up to +10% now, Soojin can send an initial offer and we avoid losing her.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachments: candidate_slate_emma_mark.pdf

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Runtime Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority hires: Senior Runtime Engineer x2 — slate & offer routing

Marcus — thanks for the slate. I reviewed Emma's resume and the market intel Karthik shared last quarter. Short answer: I support moving quickly.

Context / ask:
- Emma's counter is at band_max +12% which places her above our listed band for "Senior Runtime Engineer" but below principal levels. Losing her would delay a feature rollout and add pressure to the oncall rota.
- We have unallocated headcount in the Q2 tranche but the comp plan caps band exceptions without VP sign-off at +10%.

Proposal:
- Approve a local exception up to +10% immediately so Soojin can present a clean offer.
- If Emma pushes beyond that, loop Exec Compensation for an additional +2–5% top-up (requires a short justification memo).

Please confirm you and Vivek are okay with the +10% local exception and Soojin can send the offer today. I copied Karthik to confirm the comp mechanics.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Priority hires: Senior Runtime Engineer x2 — slate & offer routing

Kim / Marcus —

Quick comp note after reviewing comp bands (see attached compensation_slides_q2_2028.pptx):
- Band for Senior Runtime Engineer (SRE/Infra track) midpoint: $185k, band max: $240k total cash (base + target bonus).
- Market pressure for low-latency/LLM runtime specialists pushed median offers to band_max + ~8% in Bay Area listings last quarter.

Operational guidance:
- Approving a local exception to +10% is defensible given the role needs and the scarcity premium. Please flag as "local comp exception" in the offer memo.
- If the candidate requests above +10% we should prepare an ECR (exec comp request) with a two-paragraph business case (impact, cost vs delay). Karthik will pre-draft the template if needed.

I also recommend we include a sign-on equity pulse (one-time RSU grant at 25% of annual target) for Emma to make the offer competitive while keeping base cash within limits.

Attachments: compensation_slides_q2_2028.pptx

Karthik
Compensation Partner, People Ops

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: laura@mercer.com
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer routing & candidate communication (Emma Jenkinson)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on approvals above I prepared a draft offer packet for Emma (offer_letter_emma_draft.pdf). Key terms proposed:
- Base: $263,000 (this is band_max + ~9.6%)
- Target bonus: 15%
- Sign-on RSU (one-time): value = 0.25x annual target (vested over 2 yrs)
- Start date: flexible Apr 15–May 1
- Relocation: N/A; remote with Bay Area stipend

Routing request: please reply-all with APPROVE or COMMENT. If I don't hear a block by EOD today I will proceed to present the offer to the candidate this afternoon (laura@mercer.com is on standby to coordinate).

Attachment: offer_letter_emma_draft.pdf

Thanks —
Soojin
Talent Acquisition, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft offer routing & candidate communication (Emma Jenkinson)

All —

APPROVE. Thanks for moving quickly. I agree with the +10% local exception and the one-time RSU structure Karthik suggested. Soojin, proceed to present the offer at base = $263,000 with the outlined sign-on structure. If Emma pushes beyond +10% escalate immediately and I'll back the ECR to execs with the two-paragraph impact note.

Please copy HR-ops (hr-ops@payrollco.com) when you route the formal offer for processing and include the attachment "offer_letter_emma_draft.pdf" in the packet.

Vivek
